entries.label: Timed Research — Friday — Mega — Normal
entries.source_text: This Timed Research has three pages. Complete the tasks to earn adidas avatar items, Lucario Candy, Lucario Mega Energy, XP, Stardust, and an encounter with Lucario. If you're lucky, you may encounter a Shiny Lucario!
